themself as having caused, secured, authored, delivered, protected, or materially advanced a concrete governmental action, policy, funding award, program, or benefit.","clarification":"Classify as credit-claiming when the release links the senator to a tangible accomplishment. This includes introducing or authoring legislation framed as the senator's initiative; saying the senator secured, delivered, helped obtain, or successfully requested funding or an agency decision; taking credit for an amendment or provision adopted in legislation; or describing an official action as responding to the senator's advocacy. A claim can concern a collective accomplishment with colleagues if the senator claims a personal role.","positive_examples":[{"document_id":"2318","explanation":"Durbin explicitly claims that he helped secure an expedited environmental review and returned the South Suburban Airport project to the federal priority list."},{"document_id":"1257","explanation":"DeWine directly ties the Parma fire grant to the FIRE Act, which he says he wrote and passed."},{"document_id":"2697","explanation":"Inouye says he found an alternative federal funding source after the original emergency-funding request was denied."}],"negative_clarification":"Do not classify mere issue advocacy, criticism, policy preferences, vote explanations, condolences, event announcements, or generic announcements of agency grants as credit-claiming. A senator need not be credited merely because a release announces federal money or an agency action; the text should connect the senator to obtaining or producing it. Expressions of support for a bill, nominee, or compromise alone are also insufficient unless the senator claims authorship, successful inclusion, or another concrete achievement.","negative_examples":[{"document_id":"1957","explanation":"Dodd and Lieberman announce a DOT grant for Bradley Airport, but neither claims to have secured or influenced the award."},{"document_id":"4207","explanation":"Cornyn asks DHS to consider a levee proposal; the release reports an ongoing request rather than a completed result."},{"document_id":"656","explanation":"Kerry criticizes the administration's port-security performance but makes no claim of personal accomplishment."}]}}
